🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 volume：volume
  2. 计算 baseline：volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).median()
  3. 计算 active：volume > baseline
  4. 计算 prior_active：active.shift(1)
  5. 计算 transition：(active & ~prior_active).astype(float)
  6. 计算 close_return：close.pct_change()
  7. 计算 transition_return：transition * close_return
  8. 计算 event_count：transition.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum()
  9. 计算 carried_return：transition_return.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=30).sum() / (1.0 + event_count)
  10. 计算 overnight_downside：overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
  11. 计算 intraday_downside：intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
  12. 计算 total_energy：(overnight_downside + intraday_downside).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum()
  13. 计算 overnight_concentration：overnight_downside.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).sum() / total_energy
  14. 计算 stress：overnight_concentration * np.sqrt(total_energy)
  15. 计算 factor：carried_return / (1.0 + 5.0 * stress)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_transition_gap_stress_carry_30d(df): """Smoothed directional carry ">class="kw">from volume-state transitions with overnight-stress attenuation.""" df_copy = df.copy() volume = df_copy["volume"] baseline = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median() active = volume > baseline prior_active = active.shift(1).fillna("kw">class="kw">False) transition = (active & ~prior_active).astype(float) close_return = df_copy["close"].pct_change() transition_return = transition * close_return event_count = transition.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() carried_return = transition_return.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() / (1.0 + event_count) overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) overnight_downside = overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) intraday_downside = intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) total_energy = (overnight_downside + intraday_downside).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() overnight_concentration = overnight_downside.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / total_energy.replace(0.0, np.nan) stress = overnight_concentration * np.sqrt(total_energy) factor = carried_return / (1.0 + 5.0 * stress) "kw">class="kw">return factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).rename("factor_volume_transition_gap_stress_carry_30d")
